extraction.Name: Matilda Emery
extraction.Recorded patent: No, I never signed a receipt.
extraction.Buyer: not stated; all I got out of it was $400.00 and that was not all cash; he turned in a car on the deal but it was no good, and he took the car back and I didn't get nothing out of it.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered by mail at Bonesteel, S.D.; Adolph Stamer got the patent and then sent for her to come and sign it. Land was never mortgaged. Does not still own the land. Has five boys and one [girl, text unclear]. Husband and she parted. States: 'I think I would have been better off if I had never received the patents. I would have had a better home for my children and myself.' Dependent children noted; making a living for them as husband and she parted.
